content.mission: Lead incident management for major train service disruptions with the rail operators, within the Land Transport Emergency Plan.

sequence.label: Crisis team
sequence.action: Activate LTA's Crisis Management Team to assist during the disruption.

sequence.label: Bridging buses
sequence.action: Have the rail operator activate its incident management plan, including free bridging bus services between affected stations.

sequence.label: Direct commuters
sequence.action: Deploy staff to direct commuters to unaffected lines and bridging bus points, and make station and in-train announcements.

sequence.label: Bus traffic
sequence.action: Enhance bus services and manage traffic for the better movement of buses.

sequence.label: Coordinate agencies
sequence.action: Coordinate the response across government agencies.

review.notes: Disruption (rail_incident, phase 2) rather than attack response; applies_to left empty because phase 2 keys are not live.
